placements.role: Provides coherent optical transport and pluggable optics for data-center interconnection.

role_evidence.claim: Cignal AI includes Ciena among suppliers tracked for datacom and coherent optical components used in high-speed data-center links.

business_summary: Ciena Corporation provides coherent optical transport systems and pluggable optics used for data-center interconnection, historically sold heavily into telecom carrier networks and increasingly into cloud and AI data-center links. It sits on the networking-optics link only.

exposure_summary.narrative: Cignal AI includes Ciena among suppliers tracked for datacom and coherent optical components used in high-speed data-center links, a credible dated source without a revenue split between Ciena's telecom-carrier and data-center-interconnect customer bases.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: No revenue-exposure percentage for this chain's links is disclosed in the sources on file: the mapping role_evidence for CIENA carries qualitative product/operator claims, not a segment revenue split, and no data/edgar/docs/CIEN.json filing is on disk this run to check for one.

latest_fy.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CIEN.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
latest_fy.basis: Revenues for fiscal year ended 2025-11-01 as reported to SEC XBRL.

revenue_cagr_3y.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CIEN.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year compound annual revenue growth computed as (4769507000 / 3632661000) ** (1/3) - 1 from the companyfacts Revenues series, fiscal year ended 2022-10-29 to fiscal year ended 2025-11-01.

operating_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CIEN.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_margin.basis: OperatingIncomeLoss 197531000 divided by Revenues 4769507000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-11-01, both from companyfacts.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CIEN.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities 806093000 divided by net income 123338000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-11-01, both from companyfacts.

fcf_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CIEN.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 806093000 less capital expenditure 140801000, divided by revenue 4769507000, all for the fiscal year ended 2025-11-01 from companyfacts.

net_debt_to_ebitda.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CIEN.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 474413000 (total debt 1519539000 as of 2026-05-02 less cash 1045126000 as of 2026-05-02) divided by an EBITDA proxy 301664000 (operating income 197531000 plus depreciation 104133000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-11-01).

piotroski.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/CIEN.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 7 (state STRONG) computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/CIEN.json quality.piotroski.

beneish_state.basis: data/market/CIEN.json quality.beneish.state is PENDING_DATA: insufficient companyfacts inputs to score Beneish for CIEN.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 53366208572.0 = SEC companyfacts diluted share count 141016300 (as of 2025-11-01) multiplied by the close 378.44 of 2026-08-28 from the repo's own market plane (data/market/CIEN.json), not an issuer document.

price_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/CIEN.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts revenue
price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 53366208572.0 divided by fiscal year 2025-11-01 revenue 4769507000.

price_to_earnings.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/CIEN.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts net income
price_to_earnings.basis: Market capitalization 53366208572.0 divided by fiscal year 2025-11-01 GAAP net income 123338000.

ev_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/CIEN.json quality.derived.enterprise_value over SEC companyfacts revenue
ev_to_sales.basis: Enterprise value 53840621572.0 divided by fiscal year 2025-11-01 revenue 4769507000.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 53840621572.0 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 665292000.0, solved by bisection on FCF CAGR at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth. The discount rate and terminal growth are assumed, so the solve is an assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon ({'5': 0.4595, '7': 0.3316, '10': 0.2433}). It measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a statement about price, and inherits the same assumed discount rate and terminal growth.

risks.claim: Operating margin is only 4.1% and net income of $123.3M on $4.77B of revenue is thin (2.6% net margin); price-to-earnings of 432.7x is a direct consequence of that thin base rather than of the operating business alone.

risks.claim: Ciena's traditional customer base is telecom carriers, a slower and more cyclical spending pattern than hyperscale AI capex; the data-center-interconnect growth story sits alongside that legacy exposure rather than replacing it.
risks.source_name: Cignal AI Optical Components Report summary

disposition.basis: Newly profiled to close the networking-optics link's zero-coverage gap. Retained at O2: real coherent-optics exposure and strong cash conversion, but thin net margin and legacy telecom-carrier concentration temper the un-crowded case.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported. INFERRED is a figure computed from SEC companyfacts, with the derivation named in its basis. SPECULATIVE is reserved for the reverse-DCF solve, whose discount rate and terminal growth are assumed. NULL is a field looked for and not found or unusable without mixing reporting periods, never estimated.

notes: Profiles are medium-depth reusable research. This file carries no final verdict, no entry zone and no red team; those belong to the deep-dive stage.
Data tier (T1/T2/T3) describes data availability. Opportunity tier (O1/O2/O3) describes research priority. Neither implies the other.
